english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial noun for a person who habitually tells lies.
Use this when “storyteller” means a person who habitually tells lies or fibs.

examples.english: They tell lies all the time; they’re a real liar.
examples.traditional: 佢成日講大話，真係個大話精。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gong2 daai6 waa6 zan1 hai6 go3 daai6 waa6 zing1

examples.english: That storyteller is a liar; they can even make up a story about being late.
examples.traditional: 佢係個大話精，連自己遲到都可以作故仔。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 go3 daai6 waa6 zing1 lin4 zi6 gei2 ci4 dou3 dou1 ho2 ji5 zok3 gu3 zai2
